review.note: Replaced 2026-08-27: the previous asset's licence was unconfirmed (likely CC BY-NC-SA community source), which blocked commercial reuse. Regenerated as an original procedural texture — no external asset, no third-party licence, no attribution needed. Parameters follow Vernazza et al. 2019 (VLT/SPHERE): a 'basin-free' near-perfect sphere with only two distinct small craters identified in the imagery, so it gets exactly two shallow craters and is otherwise the smoothest of the six generated bodies.
